(65)༄༅/ /shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ind+ra nī la'i do shal zhes bya ba/mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i dkyil 'kha

tei:div.tei:p: shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ind+ra nī la'i do shal zhes bya ba/ mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang*// dbyer med mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs// rin chen brtson 'grus dbon ston skyer sgang pa// gnyan ston chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa mchog /rin chen brgyud pa lnga la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub khyung po sne ston yon tshul dang*// rdo rje tshul khrims steng ba tshul khrims bstan// bla ma bsod mdzes yon tan rgyal ba'i mtshan// 'dren mchog rin chen bstan pa rgyas pa sogs// bka' babs rim brgyud rnams la= mkhas btsun sangs rgyas 'jag chen byams pa dpal// chos dpal bzang po 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan dang*// mkhyen rab mchog grub kun bzang chos nyid sogs// bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la= gtsang ma shangs ston khyung po tshul khrims mgon// ri khrod ras chen shangs dkar rin rgyal ba// sangs rgyas dpal bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// rgya sgom legs rgyal sems kyi mdud grol mchog /lha dbang grags pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan te// khyad 'phags rtsa ba'i brgyud par= brgyud srol kun 'dus gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon// ye shes rgya mtsho blo gros rnam par rgyal// rin chen mnyam bzhag ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*// sbyin pa'i mtshan can rnam rgyal don kun grub// tshe dbang kun khyab phrin las rab rgyas mchog /'od gsal 'gyur med blo gros mtha' yas zhabs// sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin nor bu don kun grub// 'khor lo'i mgon po rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// smin grol gdams pa'i bka' srol nub med du// 'dzin mdzad dam pa rnams la= dgyes rdor gsang 'dus bde mchog sgyu ma che// 'jig mdzad ye shes rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa// mkha' 'gro sde lnga myur mdzad mgon po sogs// zung 'jug snying po'i lha la=(66)smin byed dbang bzhi'i rigs kyi gsos thebs nas// dam tshig rnam dag mthun rkyen gegs med tshogs// bskyed rim brten thob rdzogs rim mtha' ru phyin// mi slob zung 'jug tshe 'dir mngon byed shog

/de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// bla ma lhag pa'i lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// dka' ba med par rdo rje'i sa lam bgrod// dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi// byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la rab zhugs te// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las 'khor lor myur du 'god nus shog /ces shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong 'di'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
